notes:
Jump to any chapter, keep your library safe, and choose your narrator.

CHAPTER NAVIGATOR — tap the chapter name anywhere (a series page, mid-read, or in the player) and the whole list opens. Search it, type a chapter number to jump straight there, or use the range pills on a 900-chapter series. Chapters you've finished carry a water fill so you can see how far you've come, and the list opens parked on where you left off.

BACKUP AND RESTORE — Settings › Backup writes your library, reading progress and settings to a file you keep. Restoring merges it back in: chapters read on either device stay read, and your place only ever moves forward, so restoring an old backup can never send you back to chapter one.

THE NARRATOR NOW ASKS FIRST — the first time you press Listen, Manga Rain asks whether you want the natural-sounding narrator (a one-time 139 MB download) or your phone's built-in voice. No more finding the good voice by accident in Settings, and no download you didn't agree to. Either way your book starts reading immediately: pick the narrator and your phone's voice reads while it downloads, then the good one takes over mid-chapter.

Voice fixes throughout. A download that got interrupted could leave the app convinced the voice was installed when it wasn't — that's fixed, and a half-finished download now repairs itself instead of being stuck forever. If a download fails, Settings tells you and it tries again the next time you play something, instead of quietly retrying in the background and eating your data. And the voice name shown while you listen is now the voice actually reading.

Also fixed: stopping narration during a slow start could let the paragraph blurt out afterwards; the chapter list's range pills showed positions instead of real chapter numbers on series with gaps; typing a chapter number that doesn't exist silently opened the nearest one; and the chapter buttons drifted up the page at large text sizes.
